stem.text: A large amount of $\text{N}_2\text{O(g)}$ decomposes into nitrogen gas and oxygen gas in the presence of a tiny amount of a gold foil catalyst.
The gold foil provides a solid surface on which the catalysed reaction takes place.
The graph shows the concentration of $\text{N}_2\text{O(g)}$ against time as it decomposes. The graph is a straight line.

stem.alt: Graph of concentration of N2O(g) against time: a straight line sloping downwards from time 0 to time 10 min

items: the change in rate of reaction as $\text{N}_2\text{O(g)}$ decomposes from 0 to 10 minutes
the effect of adding more gold foil catalyst on the rate of decomposition of the same amount and concentration of $\text{N}_2\text{O(g)}$?
